MonitoredSource.title: MonitoredSource
MonitoredSource.description: A user-configured job listing website or feed monitored by JobPulse for low-latency posting alerts.

name.description: Display label for the job board (e.g., Mercor, micro1, Turing, TELUS Digital).

url.description: HTTPS URL of the career board, ATS endpoint, or RSS feed.

enabled.description: Whether live polling is enabled for this website.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Target low-latency check interval in seconds (10-3600).

lastLatencyMs.description: Most recent HTTP response latency in milliseconds.

lastJobCount.description: Number of job postings discovered on the last scan.

lastError.description: Optional error summary if the most recent fetch failed.

etag.description: Optional HTTP ETag header for low-latency conditional requests.

lastModifiedHeader.description: Optional HTTP Last-Modified header for conditional requests.

lastCheckedAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the last scan (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CustomFilter.title: CustomFilter
CustomFilter.description: A user-defined filter rule controlling which newly detected jobs trigger instant push alerts.

enabled.description: Whether this filter rule is active.

matchMode.description: Whether any or all includeKeywords must match.

includeKeywords.description: Keywords that must match the job title, company, or metadata.

excludeKeywords.description: Negative keywords that disqualify a job listing.

workMode.description: Preferred employment or work location mode.

minHourlyRate.description: Minimum USD hourly rate threshold (0 means no minimum).

targetSourceIds.description: Optional list of MonitoredSource IDs; empty applies to all sites.

instantPush.description: Whether matching postings trigger high-priority heads-up push notifications.

JobAlert.title: JobAlert
JobAlert.description: A job listing detected from a monitored website and persisted for user review, bookmarking, and application tracking.

sourceId.description: ID of the MonitoredSource where this job was detected.

sourceName.description: Display name of the source website.

fingerprint.description: Deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint preventing duplicate alerts.

compensation.description: Extracted hourly rate or salary string.

jobUrl.description: Direct HTTPS/HTTP link to the job listing.

matchedFilterNames.description: Names of custom filters matched by this job.

detectionLatencyMs.description: Fetch and parse latency in milliseconds when detected.

freshAlert.description: True when detected as a brand-new posting after initial baseline.

bookmarked.description: Whether the user bookmarked this job.

read.description: Whether the user has viewed this alert.

applied.description: Whether the user marked this job as applied.

/users/{userId}/sources/{sourceId}.description: User-owned job websites monitored for instant job alerts.

/users/{userId}/filters/{filterId}.description: User-owned custom keyword, rate, and work-mode alert filters.

/users/{userId}/alerts/{alertId}.description: User-owned detected job postings and saved application status.
